defaults.note: The default command set every mode follows; only Retake's capacity (9) differs.

plugins.name: AutoReady
plugins.note: FaceIt warmup automation, built in-house from the project below.

plugins.name: PanelBridge
plugins.note: Shared single copy in manager/shared/plugins/PanelBridge, built from the project below. Exposes SteamID64 player data over RCON for the panel.

configs.name: server.cfg
configs.note: Shared base profile in manager/shared/cfg/server.cfg, mounted into every mode and exec'd first by mode_faceit.cfg. Mode files carry only their own convars on top of it.

actions.label: Start Match
actions.description: Starts the MatchZy match flow. The game container stays running.

actions.label: Force Start Match
actions.description: Starts the MatchZy match immediately, bypassing normal readiness.

actions.label: Restart Match
actions.description: Resets the current MatchZy match. This does not restart the container.

actions.label: End Match
actions.description: Ends the active MatchZy match and records the result state.

actions.label: Pause Match
actions.description: Requests the normal MatchZy tactical pause.

actions.label: Unpause Match
actions.description: Requests MatchZy to resume a normally paused match.

actions.label: Force Pause
actions.description: Immediately pauses the MatchZy match, ignoring normal pause rules.

actions.label: Force Unpause
actions.description: Immediately resumes the MatchZy match, ignoring normal pause rules.

actions.label: Toggle Knife Round
actions.description: Toggles MatchZy's knife-round setting; it does not restart the server.

actions.label: Skip Veto
actions.description: Skips the current map-veto phase and advances the match flow.

actions.label: Show Match Settings
actions.description: Prints MatchZy settings to the console without changing server state.
